senses.gloss: (cmp. סָכָה) to look to, take in view.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:10">Macc. III, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Makkot 22a:15">22ᵃ</cite>) (ref. to <he>במספר</he> <cite ref="Deuteronomy 25:3">Deut. XXV, 3</cite>, combined with <he>ארבעים</he> of next verse) <he>מנין שהוא סוֹכֵם את הארבעים</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שהוא סמוך לארב׳</he>) a number which faces (is matched in counting with) forty, (i.e. thirty nine); ib. 22ᵇ; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 937">Yalk. Deut. 937</cite> <he>סמוך את וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 581:6">Yalk. Zech. 581</cite> <he>סוכם</he>; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 286:8">Sifré Deut. 286</cite> <he>סמוך לארב׳</he>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 73:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIII, 7</cite> (ref. to <he>משכיות</he>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 73:2">ib.</cite>) <he>יש שהיה מַסְכִּים וכ׳</he> (ed. Bub. <he>מַשְׂכִּים</he>) one planned to become a centurio, and thou madest him a general &c.; <he>על כל מה שהיו מַסְכִּימִים העברת וכ׳</he> thou didst carry them beyond all they ever contemplated (to become).

senses.gloss: (cmp. חָשַׁב, שָׁוָה) to harmonize; to agree. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. IV, Par. 4 ואתה דורש ומַסְכִּים לשמועה and thou interpretest the text and harmonizest it with the traditional law; Yalk. Lev. 440 ומסכים הלכה and harmonizest the tradition (with the text).
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 62a:5">Yeb. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>והִסְכִּימָה דעתו לדעת וכ׳</he> and his (Moses’) opinion (the result of his deliberations) turned out to be in agreement with the Lord’s; <cite ref="Shabbat 87a:2">Sabb. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>וה׳ הקב״ה עמו</he> the Lord agreed with him; <cite ref="Shabbat 87a:3">ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ הקב״ה על ידו</he> the Lord approved his doing; a. fr.
